text:
anya: FYI product wants a "delegate routing control" flow for tenant admins so they can tweak routing policies (region/cost tier) without being full org admins. quick sync?

jordan: what granularity are they expecting — whole-tenant, per-route, per-model?

anya: product asked per-route. UI should let tenant-admins pick fallback tiers and soft-quota caps per route, but not change entitlements or billing accounts. link: https://go/research/routing-delegate-proto

kevin: implementation note: our current AuthZ model has a single 'scope' object we check at request time. adding route-level policy means either: (A) have authz include route-policy attrs on each token, or (B) add a route-entitlements lookup during routing. (B) seems safer but adds a hot path.

maria: big perf concern with (B) — route calls are QPS-heavy. we should avoid sync RPCs to authz on every request. options: precompute effective-routing-policies into the routing cache (hot path), or embed a compact policy-hash in tokens and validate TTL.

kevin: prototype idea — new preview API: `/v1/entitlements/route-preview?tenant_id=...&route=...` returns compact list of allowed fallbacks and soft-quota ceilings. cache TTL 30s in the routing plane. telemetry events `ent_preview_hit`, `ent_preview_miss`, `ent_preview_stale` for ops.

aisha: API debate: should we return full computed policy JSON in route metadata (so console can render immediately) or return a small token and have console call preview endpoint? returning in metadata saves an extra call but increases payload size and complexity for cache invalidation.

jordan: also need to consider canary rollouts: we want delegated changes to be opt-in for some tenants and have rollback. UI needs a preview that shows "effective behavior" before commit.

anya: UX: in console show a read-only "effective routing preview" for tenant-admins and a separate "apply" flow that creates a scoped-policy record in our control-plane. apply should be behind an enterprise feature flag.

maria: telemetry hooks: track `delegation_preview_open`, `delegation_apply_attempt`, `delegation_apply_success`, and `delegation_apply_reject` with minimal PII. that will help detect misconfigurations and abuse.

kevin: implementation checklist:
```
- add /v1/entitlements/route-preview (compute from tenant policy + route defaults)
- cache in routing plane with 30s TTL + invalidation on policy change
- console calls preview on modal open; show diff UI
- feature-flag gating + canary 10% tenants
- telemetry events + dashboard
```

deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-routing-service v3.9.1 rolled to prod at 2412345700 :rocket:

aisha: edge-case: what if tenant-admin sets a fallback that references a model the tenant isn't licensed for? preview must show a validation error and disable apply.

kevin: yep — validation ruleset will be enforced server-side. preview returns `[valid: bool, errors: [string]]` along with the computed policy.

anya: sounds good. I'll draft a short RFC for the rollout plan + console mock and post by EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:
